timebase.frame_policy: Use seconds as truth. At export fps, map each frame to exactly one half-open interval; never round each duration separately.

lyric_policy: lyric_lines are all local source intervals overlapping a shot; repeated indices across cuts are intentional. Use local text only. No subtitle retiming approved. Source section.end values are not vocal-offset measurements.

beat_grid.note: Local onset phase differs ~16ms; analysis window ~93ms. Reference values are not transferred as approved cues. Line-led cuts deliberately may fall off-grid.
